businessDomain: Home of the company's AI agents: agents, drafts, behavior and simulation live in the cm (collab messages) and are read and changed through it; this module owns the tool catalog of the app modules and the cm, which tools each agent has on, which people may not use a tool, and the execution summaries the cm sends.

entities.title: Agent
entities.description: An AI agent of the organization as the cm keeps it: definition, @name, who it talks to, on whose behalf it acts, whether it is on, who is responsible and its limits. Read and changed only through the cm.

entities.title: Agent draft
entities.description: A virtual employee the cm prepares from the admin's prompt, with its situation (preparing, ready, or refused with the reason); it is activated or discarded through the cm and stays in the cm.

entities.title: Agent behavior
entities.description: The current behavior of an agent in plain language (role and state texts in the cm) and the history of its changes with author, date and a one-line summary; changed or undone through the cm.

entities.title: Personal conduct
entities.description: How an agent that acts on a member's behalf behaves for that member, with the history of the member's own changes; kept and changed in the cm.

entities.title: Agent simulation
entities.description: A simulation run by the cm at two levels: what the agent can do for a person or role, and what it understands from a sentence. Nothing is saved.

entities.title: Tool
entities.description: One action of the tool catalog, from an app module or from the cm itself, placed in the module / subject / action tree with a readable name and description. Rebuilt when a module is created or a release arrives; a tool that leaves the release is marked removed and never deleted.

entities.title: Agent tool
entities.description: Whether one tool is on or off for one agent, and whether that choice was made by the admin or by the automatic choice; an admin's choice is never changed automatically.

entities.title: Person tool restriction
entities.description: A tool a given person may not use through any agent, marked by the company admin.

entities.title: Execution summary
entities.description: The summary of one finished execution of an agent sent by the cm: when, how long, cost, actions and their results, whether a person took over, and the link to the conversation. The same execution is never recorded twice.

entities.title: Organization user
entities.description: A person of the organization chosen from the platform user list: the person whose tools are restricted, or the person who called an agent in an execution.

relationships.description: Each agent tool choice refers to one tool of the catalog.
Each agent tool choice belongs to one agent of the cm (or its draft); the table stores the cm id.
Each restriction applies to one organization user.
Each restriction blocks one tool of the catalog.
Each execution summary is about one agent; the table stores the cm id.
The person who called the agent in the execution, when known.
